items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Mildred and Willard were very close.

ctx.x: But having done the vocal, Mildred and Willard were very close. You know, they were mutual admirers. And I did that and Joe Turner Blues. We -- all these things out of the book.

And the other day I spent an awful lot of time trying to remember them. But they came so fast, and I would go up there with Willard and do this work with him. And, you know, his rehearsals were always nice. He had good studio musicians, bass clarinets, mostly clarinets, (inaudible) mostly saxophone and strings and viola. He had some fine musicians in there and some nice rehearsals and some nice sounds.
